scanNote: Writing (Project) kitobning oxiridagi 'Photo File' bo'limidagi rasmlarga tayanadi. O'sha rasmlar bu betda yo'q, shuning uchun ular to'qib yozilmadi — buning o'rniga bu betdagi ikki qutidan (hikoya boshlanishi va tugashi) kelib chiqadigan TUZILISH va namuna qoliplar berildi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the adjectives from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (5 ta sifat, 5 ta bo'shliq):
  beautiful, sunny, shocking, white, happy

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Everything was ready for Sally's wedding that SUNNY day.
  She put on her WHITE silk dress and went downstairs. Just
  then, a BEAUTIFUL bouquet of flowers arrived for her.
  Sally had a HAPPY smile on her face. "From David," she
  thought. Suddenly, she screamed as she read the SHOCKING
  message on the bouquet.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  O'sha quyoshli kuni Sallining to'yi uchun hammasi tayyor
  edi. U oq ipak ko'ylagini kiydi va pastga tushdi. Shu
  payt unga go'zal gul dastasi keldi. Sallining yuzida
  baxtli tabassum bor edi. "Deviddan," — deb o'yladi u.
  To'satdan gul dastasidagi hayratlanarli xabarni o'qib
  qichqirib yubordi.

USUL — MANTIQQA QARANG:
  ... day      → ob-havo → sunny
  ... silk dress → to'y ko'ylagi rangi → white
  ... bouquet  → gul dastasi qanday? → beautiful
  ... smile    → to'y kuni tabassum → happy
  ... message  → nega qichqirdi? → shocking

DIQQAT — HIKOYA TUZILISHI:
  Boshida hammasi YAXShI (sunny, white, beautiful, happy),
  oxirida esa YOMON (shocking) — bu qarama-qarshilik
  hikoyani QIZIQARLI qiladi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a wedding    = to'y
  silk         = ipak
  downstairs   = pastga (zinadan)
  a bouquet    = gul dastasi
  a smile      = tabassum
  shocking     = hayratlanarli, dahshatli
  a message    = xabar

items.textEn: 1  Everything was ready for Sally's wedding that ............ day.
items.whyUz:
'that SUNNY day' = o'sha quyoshli kun.
'sun' + -y → sifat.
To'y kuni — quyoshli, yaxshi ob-havo.

items.textEn: 2  She put on her ............ silk dress ...
items.whyUz:
'her WHITE silk dress' = oq ipak ko'ylagi.
An'anaviy to'y ko'ylagi OQ rangda.
'silk' = ipak (ot, lekin sifat vazifasida).
Sifatlar tartibi: rang (white) → material (silk).

items.textEn: 3  Just then, a ............ bouquet of flowers arrived for her.
items.whyUz:
'a BEAUTIFUL bouquet' = go'zal gul dastasi.
'a bouquet OF flowers' — 'of' shart.
'Just then' — 77-betdagi ketma-ketlik so'zi.

items.textEn: 4  Sally had a ............ smile on her face.
items.whyUz:
'a HAPPY smile' = baxtli tabassum.
Gul kelgani uchun xursand edi.
'on her face' = yuzida.

items.textEn: 5  Suddenly, she screamed as she read the ............ message on the bouquet.
items.whyUz:
'the SHOCKING message' = hayratlanarli xabar.
'shocking' — u qichqirishga sabab bo'lgan.
DIQQAT: bu — hikoyadagi BURILISh nuqtasi.
Oldingi to'rt sifat IJOBIY, bu esa SALBIY.
'as' bu yerda = ...ganda.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the examples, then complete the rules.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI MISOLLAR:

  He was a CAREFUL driver.  →  He drove CAREFULLY.
  The HAPPY child smiled.   →  The child smiled HAPPILY.
  She was a FAST runner.    →  She could run very FAST.
  They were GOOD singers.   →  They sang very WELL.

UCHTA QOIDA:

  1) Ravishni odatda sifatga -LY qo'shib yasaymiz.
        careful → carefully
        loud    → loudly
        quick   → quickly

  2) Sifat UNDOSH + Y bilan tugasa, -Y ni tushirib,
     -ILY qo'shamiz.
        happy  → happily
        easy   → easily
        lucky  → luckily

  3) Ba'zi ravishlar SIFAT bilan BIR XIL shaklda bo'ladi.
        hard  → hard
        fast  → fast
        early → early
     LEKIN:  good → WELL

DIQQAT — 2-QOIDA FAQAT UNDOSH + Y UCHUN:
  UNDOSH + Y → -ILY
     hapPY  → happily   (p — undosh)
     easY   → easily    (s — undosh)
  Bu — o'tgan zamondagi -IED qoidasiga o'xshash
  (marry → married).

DIQQAT — 3-QOIDADAGI TUZOQ:
  'hardly' shakli BOR, lekin ma'nosi BOShQA!
     hard   = qattiq, ko'p  (He works HARD.)
     hardly = deyarli emas  (He HARDLY works.)
  Ikkalasi BUTUNLAY teskari ma'no beradi.

  Shunga o'xshash:
     late   = kech          (He came LATE.)
     lately = so'nggi paytda (I haven't seen him LATELY.)

items.textEn: We usually form adverbs by adding ............ to the adjective.
items.whyUz:
SIFAT + -LY = RAVISH.
Bu — asosiy qoida.
Misol: careful → carefully;  loud → loudly.

items.textEn: When the adjective ends with a consonant + y, we drop the ............ and add ............ to form the adverb.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'-Y' TUShADI.
happy → happ + ily = happily.

items.textEn: When the adjective ends with a consonant + y, we drop the -y and add ............ to form the adverb.  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'-ILY' QO'ShILADI.
happy → happily;  easy → easily;  lucky → luckily.
DIQQAT: o'tgan zamondagi -IED qoidasiga o'xshash.

items.textEn: Some adverbs have the same form as their ............ .
items.whyUz:
Ba'zi ravishlar SIFAT bilan BIR XIL.
hard → hard;  fast → fast;  early → early.
LEKIN: good → WELL (istisno).
DIQQAT: 'fastly' va 'goodly' shakllari YO'Q.

exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ SIFAT — UCHALA QOIDA HAM SINALADI:

  ODDIY + LY:
     strange → strangely
     desperate → desperately
     quick → quickly

  UNDOSH + Y → -ILY:
     happy → happily
     easy  → easily

  SIFAT bilan BIR XIL:
     hard → hard
     fast → fast

  ISTISNO:
     good → WELL

items.whyUz:
hard → HARD (sifat bilan bir xil).
'He works HARD.' = U ko'p ishlaydi.
DIQQAT: 'hardly' shakli BOR, lekin ma'nosi TESKARI —
'deyarli emas'.
'He HARDLY works' = U deyarli ishlamaydi.

strange → strangely.
Oxiri '-e' bo'lsa ham, faqat -LY qo'shiladi
('strangeely' XATO — 'e' saqlanadi).
'He behaved STRANGELY.' = U g'alati o'zini tutdi.

happy → HAPPILY.
'p' undosh + 'y' → 'y' tushadi, -ILY qo'shiladi.
Kitobdagi misol: 'The child smiled HAPPILY.'

items.textEn: desperate  →  ............
items.whyUz:
desperate → desperately.
77-betdagi hikoyada bor:
'Claire screamed DESPERATELY.'

fast → FAST (sifat bilan bir xil).
Kitobdagi misol: 'She could run very FAST.'
'fastly' shakli YO'Q.

easy → EASILY.
's' undosh + 'y' → -ILY.
'happy → happily' bilan bir xil qoida.

good → WELL — ISTISNO.
'goodly' shakli YO'Q.
Kitobdagi misol: 'They sang very WELL.'
DIQQAT: 'well' sifat sifatida ham ishlatiladi —
'I feel WELL' = o'zimni yaxshi his qilaman (sog'lom).

quick → quickly.
77-betdagi hikoyada bor:
'jumped out of the car QUICKLY'.

exercises.instructionEn: We can join sentences with words such as and, but, because, so, then, when, etc.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni and, but, because, so, then, when kabi so'zlar bilan bog'lashimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI OLTI MISOL:

  AND — qo'shimcha, ketma-ketlik
     She stood up AND walked towards the door.
     (U o'rnidan turdi va eshik tomon yurdi.)

  BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK
     He looked out of the window, BUT he couldn't see
     anything.
     (U derazadan qaradi, lekin hech narsa ko'ra olmadi.)

  BECAUSE — SABAB
     He closed the window BECAUSE it was very cold outside.
     (U derazani yopdi, chunki tashqarida juda sovuq edi.)

  SO — NATIJA
     It was very late, SO he decided to go home.
     (Juda kech edi, shuning uchun uyga ketishga qaror qildi.)

  THEN — KETMA-KETLIK
     He opened the door, THEN turned on the lights.
     (U eshikni ochdi, so'ng chiroqlarni yoqdi.)

  WHEN — VAQT
     He was in bed WHEN he heard a strange noise.
     (U to'shakda edi, o'shanda g'alati shovqin eshitdi.)


ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK — 'BECAUSE' va 'SO':

  Ikkalasi ham SABAB-NATIJA aloqasini ko'rsatadi,
  lekin TARTIBI TESKARI:

     NATIJA + BECAUSE + SABAB
        He closed the window BECAUSE it was cold.
        (yopdi ← chunki sovuq edi)

     SABAB + SO + NATIJA
        It was cold, SO he closed the window.
        (sovuq edi → shuning uchun yopdi)

  Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat tartib boshqacha.

DIQQAT — VERGUL:
  'but' va 'so' oldidan odatda VERGUL qo'yiladi.
  'and', 'because', 'when' oldidan odatda vergul YO'Q.

DIQQAT — EGA TAKRORLANMASLIGI:
  'and' va 'then' bilan bog'langanda, ega BIR XIL bo'lsa
  ikkinchisida tushirib qoldirsa bo'ladi:
     She stood up and (she) walked towards the door.
     He opened the door, then (he) turned on the lights.

points.en: She stood up and walked towards the door.
points.uz: U o'rnidan turdi va eshik tomon yurdi.
points.noteUz:
AND — ketma-ketlik.
Ega ('she') ikkinchi qismda TUShIB QOLGAN.
stand → STOOD (noto'g'ri fe'l).

points.en: He looked out of the window, but he couldn't see anything.
points.uz: U derazadan qaradi, lekin hech narsa ko'ra olmadi.
points.noteUz:
BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK.
Oldidan VERGUL.
'look OUT OF the window' = derazadan qaramoq.

points.en: He closed the window because it was very cold outside.
points.uz: U derazani yopdi, chunki tashqarida juda sovuq edi.
points.noteUz:
BECAUSE — SABAB.
Oldidan odatda vergul YO'Q.
Tartib: NATIJA + because + SABAB.

points.en: It was very late, so he decided to go home.
points.uz: Juda kech edi, shuning uchun uyga ketishga qaror qildi.
points.noteUz:
SO — NATIJA.
Oldidan VERGUL.
Tartib: SABAB + so + NATIJA — 'because' ning TESKARISI.

points.en: He opened the door, then turned on the lights.
points.uz: U eshikni ochdi, so'ng chiroqlarni yoqdi.
points.noteUz:
THEN — KETMA-KETLIK.
Ega ikkinchi qismda TUShIB QOLGAN.
'turn on' = yoqmoq (chiroq, televizor).

points.en: He was in bed when he heard a strange noise.
points.uz: U to'shakda edi, o'shanda g'alati shovqin eshitdi.
points.noteUz:
WHEN — VAQT.
'in bed' = to'shakda (artikl YO'Q).
hear → HEARD (noto'g'ri fe'l).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story in Ex. 4 again and find one example sentence for each of the following linking words: and, but, because.
exercises.instructionUz: 4-mashqdagi hikoyani yana o'qing va quyidagi bog'lovchilarning har biriga bittadan misol gap toping: and, but, because.
exercises.explanationUz:
77-BETDAGI HIKOYADAN MISOLLAR:

  Hikoyada bu bog'lovchilar bir necha marta uchraydi —
  har biriga BITTA misol yetarli.

BOShQA MUMKIN BO'LGAN MISOLLAR:

  AND:
     'She beeped the horn AND shouted for help.'
     'Claire and Greg jumped out of the car quickly AND
      ran towards the jeep.'
     'another jeep arrived AND chased away the lions'

  BUT:
     'He tried to start the car several times, BUT nothing
      happened.'
     'They wanted to jump out of the car, BUT they couldn't'
     'They were still shocked, BUT happy.'

  BECAUSE:
     '... they couldn't BECAUSE the lions were around it.'
     (hikoyada 'because' FAQAT BIR MARTA uchraydi)

items.textEn: AND — misol gap toping
items.answer: She beeped the horn and shouted for help.
items.whyUz:
AND — ketma-ketlik va qo'shimcha.
DIQQAT: ega ('she') ikkinchi qismda TUShIB QOLGAN —
'she beeped ... and (she) shouted ...'
Boshqa misol: 'jumped out of the car quickly AND ran
towards the jeep'.

items.textEn: BUT — misol gap toping
items.answer: They're beautiful, but very scary animals.
items.whyUz:
BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK: go'zal ↔ qo'rqinchli.
Boshqa misollar:
  'He tried to start the car ..., BUT nothing happened.'
  'They were still shocked, BUT happy.'

items.textEn: BECAUSE — misol gap toping
items.answer: They wanted to jump out of the car, but they couldn't because the lions were around it.
items.whyUz:
BECAUSE — SABAB: sherlar atrofda edi.
DIQQAT: hikoyada 'because' FAQAT BIR MARTA uchraydi.
Bu gapda IKKI bog'lovchi bor: 'but' (qarama-qarshilik)
va 'because' (sabab).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in and, but, because, so, then or when.
exercises.instructionUz: and, but, because, so, then yoki when ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI BOG'LOVCHI, OLTI GAP — har biri BIR MARTA.

USUL — IKKINCHI QISMGA SAVOL BERING:

  'Nega?' javobi bormi?         → BECAUSE
  Birinchisining NATIJASImi?     → SO
  Birinchisiga QARAMA-QARShImi?  → BUT
  'Qachon?' javobi bormi?        → WHEN
  Ketma-ket voqeami?             → THEN yoki AND

THEN va AND FARQI:
  AND  — ikki harakat, ega BIR XIL, ketma-ketlik
         yoki shunchaki qo'shimcha
  THEN — ketma-ketlikni ANIQ ta'kidlaydi
         (avval bu, keyin u)

BECAUSE va SO FARQI — ENG MUHIM:
  NATIJA + BECAUSE + SABAB
  SABAB  + SO      + NATIJA

items.textEn: 1  The door was not locked, ............ Mike opened it and went inside.
items.whyUz:
SABAB (eshik qulflanmagan) → NATIJA (Mayk ochdi) → SO.
Oldidan VERGUL bor — bu ham 'so' ni ko'rsatadi.
DIQQAT: 'because' bo'lsa tartib teskari bo'lardi:
'Mike opened the door BECAUSE it was not locked.'

items.textEn: 2  First, the sky turned grey, ............ it began to rain.
items.whyUz:
'First' so'zi bor → keyingi voqea 'THEN' bilan.
KETMA-KETLIK: avval osmon kulrang bo'ldi, so'ng yomg'ir
yog'a boshladi.
'turn grey' = kulrang bo'lmoq.

items.textEn: 3  We waited for Rob's answer, ............ he said nothing.
items.whyUz:
QARAMA-QARShILIK: javob kutishdi ↔ u hech narsa demadi →
BUT.
Oldidan VERGUL bor.
'wait FOR' = kutmoq;  'say nothing' = hech narsa demaslik.

items.textEn: 4  Liz was in the kitchen ............ the phone rang.
items.whyUz:
VAQT: Liz oshxonada edi — O'ShANDA telefon jiringladi →
WHEN.
ring → RANG (noto'g'ri fe'l).
Kitobdagi misolga o'xshash:
'He was in bed WHEN he heard a strange noise.'

items.textEn: 5  Mr Grant opened the letter ............ read the message inside.
items.whyUz:
AND — ketma-ketlik, ega BIR XIL.
DIQQAT: ikkinchi qismda ega ('he') TUShIB QOLGAN —
'Mr Grant opened ... and (he) read ...'
Bu 'and' ning belgisi.
read → READ (yozilishi bir xil, /red/ deb o'qiladi).

items.textEn: 6  Mandy felt nervous ............ the dog looked very scary.
items.whyUz:
SABAB: it qo'rqinchli ko'rinardi → BECAUSE.
Tartib: NATIJA (asabiy edi) + BECAUSE + SABAB (it qo'rqinchli).
1-band bilan SOLISHTIRING — u yerda tartib teskari edi ('so').
'scary' — 76-betdagi so'z.

sections.title: Writing — starting and ending a story

exercises.instructionEn: When we start a story ... we write when and where the event happened, who the people in the story were and what happened first.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani boshlaganimizda voqea qachon va qayerda sodir bo'lganini, hikoyadagi odamlar kim ekanini va avval nima bo'lganini yozamiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA — HIKOYANI BOSHLASH:

  Hikoya boshlanishida TO'RT narsa bo'lishi kerak:

  1) WHEN  — voqea QAChON sodir bo'ldi
  2) WHERE — QAYERDA sodir bo'ldi
  3) WHO   — hikoyadagi odamlar KIM edi
  4) WHAT  — avval NIMA bo'ldi

77-BETDAGI HIKOYA HAM SHUNDAY BOSHLANGAN:
  'One gorgeous, sunny day LAST SUMMER (WHEN), CLAIRE and
   her friend GREG (WHO) went to LONGLEAT SAFARI PARK
   (WHERE).'

FOYDALI BOSHLANISH QOLIPLARI:
  One gorgeous, sunny day last summer, ...
  That cold winter afternoon, ...
  It was a lovely day, so ...
  Last Saturday morning, ...

DIQQAT — SIFATLAR QO'ShING:
  78-betdagi qoidani eslang:
  'One day' o'rniga 'One BEAUTIFUL SUNNY day' —
  sifatlar hikoyani qiziqarli qiladi.
exercises.bookRef: Coursebook, 79-bet, 'When we start a story' qutisi

points.en: When we start a story we write WHEN the event happened.
points.uz: Hikoyani boshlaganimizda voqea QACHON sodir bo'lganini yozamiz.
points.noteUz: Misol: 'One gorgeous, sunny day last summer'.

points.en: ... WHO the people in the story were.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture and read the short paragraph. Then, answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va qisqa matnni o'qing. So'ng savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN:
  That cold winter afternoon, I decided to take my dog,
  Rex, for a walk on the beach. Suddenly, Rex began to
  bark loudly.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  O'sha sovuq qish kunining tushdan keyingi payti men itim
  Reksni plyajda sayr qildirishga qaror qildim. To'satdan
  Reks baland ovozda hura boshladi.

RASMDA: qish kiyimidagi odam plyajda iti bilan yuribdi.

BU MATN — HIKOYA BOSHLANISHIGA NAMUNA.
Unda to'rtala savolning javobi ham bor:
  WHEN  → That cold winter afternoon
  WHERE → on the beach
  WHO   → I and my dog, Rex
  WHAT  → Rex began to bark loudly

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an afternoon = tushdan keyingi payt
  to take a dog for a walk = itni sayr qildirmoq
  the beach    = plyaj, qirg'oq
  to bark      = hurmoq (it haqida)

items.textEn: 1  When did this happen?
items.answer: It happened that cold winter afternoon.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'THAT COLD WINTER AFTERNOON'.
Hikoya boshlanishining BIRINCHI qismi — VAQT.
DIQQAT: 'cold' va 'winter' — sifatlar, matnni
qiziqarliroq qiladi.

items.textEn: 2  Where did this happen?
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'for a walk ON THE BEACH'.
Hikoya boshlanishining IKKINCHI qismi — JOY.
'ON the beach' — predlog ON.

items.textEn: 3  Who was there?
items.answer: The writer (I) and his/her dog, Rex, were there.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'I decided to take MY DOG, REX, for a walk'.
Hikoya boshlanishining UChINChI qismi — ODAMLAR.
Hikoya BIRINChI shaxsda ('I') yozilgan.

items.textEn: 4  What happened suddenly?
items.answer: Suddenly, Rex began to bark loudly.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'SUDDENLY, Rex BEGAN TO BARK LOUDLY.'
Hikoya boshlanishining TO'RTINChI qismi — birinchi voqea.
'Suddenly' — hikoyada burilish nuqtasi.
'loudly' — ravish (78-betdagi qoida).

exercises.instructionEn: When we end a story ... we write what happened in the end and how the people in the story felt.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani tugatganimizda oxirida nima bo'lganini va hikoyadagi odamlar o'zini qanday his qilganini yozamiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA — HIKOYANI TUGATISH:

  Hikoya oxirida IKKI narsa bo'lishi kerak:

  1) WHAT happened IN THE END — oxirida nima bo'ldi
  2) HOW the people FELT       — ular o'zini qanday his qildi

77-BETDAGI HIKOYA HAM SHUNDAY TUGAGAN:
  'When they were safe inside the jeep, they thanked the
   park ranger for his help. (NIMA BO'LDI)
   They were still shocked, but happy. They knew they were
   very lucky to be alive. (QANDAY HIS QILDILAR)'

HIS-TUYG'U SIFATLARI:

  IJOBIY (positive):
     happy      xursand
     proud      faxrlanuvchi
     relieved   yengil tortgan
     excited    hayajonlangan
     lucky      omadli

  SALBIY (negative):
     upset      xafa
     sad        g'amgin
     scared     qo'rqqan
     shocked    sarosimada
     angry      jahli chiqqan
     disappointed umidi puchga chiqqan

FOYDALI TUGATISH QOLIPLARI:
  In the end, ...
  Finally, ...
  They felt very ... .
  It was a(n) ... experience!
  They knew they were very lucky to ... .
exercises.bookRef: Coursebook, 79-bet, 'When we end a story' qutisi

points.en: When we end a story we write WHAT happened in the end.
points.uz: Hikoyani tugatganimizda oxirida NIMA bo'lganini yozamiz.
points.noteUz: Misol: 'they thanked the park ranger for his help'.

points.en: ... and HOW the people in the story FELT.
points.uz: ... va odamlar o'zini QANDAY HIS QILGANINI.
points.noteUz:
Misol: 'They were still shocked, but happy.'
His-tuyg'u SIFATLAR bilan ifodalanadi.

Tugatish uchun foydali iboralar.
77-betdagi ketma-ketlik so'zlaridan.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story endings and underline the adjectives which show how each person feels. Which are positive? Which are negative?
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoya tugallanmalarini o'qing va har bir odamning his-tuyg'usini ko'rsatadigan sifatlarning tagiga chizing. Qaysilari ijobiy? Qaysilari salbiy?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH TUGALLANMA — har birida BITTA his-tuyg'u sifati.

USUL:
  1) His-tuyg'uni bildiruvchi sifatni toping
  2) U IJOBIYmi yoki SALBIYmi — aniqlang

BELGILAR:
  'felt/was + SIFAT' qolipini qidiring
     I FELT very HAPPY
     Pam WAS really UPSET
     He FELT PROUD

DIQQAT — 'TO BE' va 'TO FEEL' IKKALASI HAM ISHLATILADI:
  I felt happy.  =  I was happy.
  Ma'no bir xil.

items.textEn: 1  I felt very ............ to be the winner of the competition.  (sifat qaysi? ijobiymi yoki salbiy?)
items.hintUz: G'olib bo'lgan odam nima his qiladi?
items.whyUz:
Sifat: HAPPY (xursand) → IJOBIY.
'to be the winner' = g'olib bo'lmoq.
'a competition' = musobaqa.
G'alaba — ijobiy voqea, shuning uchun his-tuyg'u ham ijobiy.

items.textEn: 2  Pam was really ............ to see him leave.  (sifat qaysi? ijobiymi yoki salbiy?)
items.whyUz:
Sifat: UPSET (xafa) → SALBIY.
'upset' = xafa, ranjigan.
'to see him leave' = uning ketishini ko'rmoq.
Ajralish — salbiy voqea.

items.textEn: 3  He felt ............ with the gold cup in his hands.  (sifat qaysi? ijobiymi yoki salbiy?)
items.hintUz: Oltin kubok qo'lida bo'lgan odam nima his qiladi?
items.whyUz:
Sifat: PROUD (faxrlanuvchi) → IJOBIY.
'proud' = faxrlanadigan, g'ururlanadigan.
'a gold cup' = oltin kubok (mukofot).
1-band bilan bir xil vaziyat — g'alaba.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures in the Photo File section, then write a beginning and an ending for the story. Use the prompts.
exercises.instructionUz: Kitobning oxiridagi Photo File bo'limidagi rasmlarga qarang, so'ng hikoyaga boshlanish va tugallanma yozing. Ko'rsatmalardan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — RASMLAR BOShQA JOYDA:
  Bu mashq kitobning OXIRIDAGI 'Photo File' bo'limidagi
  rasmlarga tayanadi. O'sha rasmlar bu betda YO'Q,
  shuning uchun bu yerda aniq hikoya TO'QIB yozilmadi.

  Quyida bu betdagi IKKI QUTIDAN kelib chiqadigan
  TUZILISH va QOLIPLAR berilgan — ular istalgan
  rasm to'plamiga mos keladi.


BOShLANISh — TO'RT SAVOLGA JAVOB BERING:

  WHEN  — Qachon?
     One gorgeous, sunny day last summer, ...
     That cold winter afternoon, ...
     Last Saturday morning, ...

  WHERE — Qayerda?
     ... at the beach / in the park / in the countryside

  WHO   — Kim?
     ... my friend Tom and I ...
     ... Claire and her friend Greg ...

  WHAT  — Avval nima bo'ldi?
     ... we decided to go for a walk.
     ... Suddenly, ...


TUGALLANMA — IKKI NARSANI YOZING:

  1) OXIRIDA NIMA BO'LDI
     In the end, ...
     Finally, ...

  2) ULAR QANDAY HIS QILDI
     We felt very happy / relieved / lucky.
     It was a horrible / wonderful experience!
     We knew we were very lucky to ... .


NAMUNA BOSHLANISh (78-betdagi Ralf hikoyasi uchun):
  It was a lovely spring morning, so Ralph decided to go
  for a ride in the countryside. He got on his horse and
  rode out of the field. At first, everything was fine.

NAMUNA TUGALLANMA (o'sha hikoya uchun):
  In the end, Ralph got out of the lake and walked home
  with his horse. He was cold and very wet, and he felt
  really embarrassed. It was a horrible experience!


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  BOShLANISh: Bahorning ajoyib tongi edi, shuning uchun
  Ralf qishloqqa ot mingani borishga qaror qildi. U otiga
  mindi va daladan chiqib ketdi. Dastlab hammasi yaxshi edi.

  TUGALLANMA: Oxir-oqibat Ralf ko'ldan chiqdi va oti bilan
  uyiga piyoda qaytdi. U sovqotgan va juda ho'l edi,
  o'zini juda uyalgan his qilardi. Bu dahshatli tajriba edi!


DIQQAT — HIKOYADA QANDAY VOSITALAR ISHLATILADI:
  • SIFATLAR (78-bet)     — hikoyani qiziqarli qiladi
  • RAVIShLAR (79-bet)    — harakatni aniq tasvirlaydi
  • KETMA-KETLIK so'zlari (77-bet) — first, then, suddenly
  • BOG'LOVChILAR (79-bet) — and, but, because, so, when
  • HARAKAT PREDLOGLARI (78-bet) — along, through, into

structure.heading: Boshlanish 1 — WHEN va WHERE
structure.guideUz:
Vaqt va joyni ayting.
SIFATLAR qo'shing — hikoyani qiziqarli qiladi.
structure.modelEn: One gorgeous, sunny day last summer, we went to the beach.

structure.heading: Boshlanish 2 — WHO
structure.guideUz:
Qahramonlarni tanishtiring.
Birinchi shaxsda ('I', 'we') yoki uchinchi shaxsda.
structure.modelEn: My friend Tom and I decided to spend the day there.

structure.heading: Boshlanish 3 — WHAT happened first
structure.guideUz:
Birinchi voqeani ayting.
'At first, everything was fine.' — foydali qolip.
structure.modelEn: At first, everything was fine. Suddenly, we heard a strange noise.

structure.heading: Tugallanma 1 — WHAT happened in the end
structure.modelEn: In the end, a park ranger came and helped us.

structure.heading: Tugallanma 2 — HOW they felt
structure.guideUz:
His-tuyg'u SIFATLARINI ishlating.
Ijobiy: happy, proud, relieved, lucky.
Salbiy: upset, scared, shocked.
structure.modelEn: We were still shocked, but happy. We knew we were very lucky. It was an experience we will never forget!

items.base: He closed the window BECAUSE it was cold.
It was cold, SO he closed the window.
items.baseUz: Sovuq edi, shuning uchun derazani yopdi.

items.base: The door was not locked, SO Mike opened it.
items.baseUz: Eshik qulflanmagan edi, shuning uchun Mayk uni ochdi.

items.base: Mandy felt nervous BECAUSE the dog looked scary.
items.baseUz: Mendi asabiylashdi, chunki it qo'rqinchli ko'rinardi.

patterns.exampleEn: The child smiled happily. She could run very fast. They sang very well.
patterns.exampleUz: Bola baxtli jilmaydi. U juda tez yugura olardi. Ular juda yaxshi kuylashdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
RAVISH fe'ldan KEYIN turadi.
'good' ning ravishi — WELL.

patterns.exampleEn: The door was not locked, so Mike opened it and went inside.
patterns.exampleUz: Eshik qulflanmagan edi, shuning uchun Mayk uni ochdi va ichkariga kirdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'so' oldidan VERGUL.
Avval sabab, keyin natija.

patterns.exampleEn: Mandy felt nervous because the dog looked very scary.
patterns.exampleUz: Mendi asabiylashdi, chunki it juda qo'rqinchli ko'rinardi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'because' — 'so' ning TESKARISI.
Avval natija, keyin sabab.

patterns.exampleEn: Liz was in the kitchen when the phone rang. He was in bed when he heard a strange noise.
patterns.exampleUz: Liz oshxonada edi, o'shanda telefon jiringladi. U to'shakda edi, o'shanda g'alati shovqin eshitdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'when' — davom etayotgan holat va TO'SATDAN bo'lgan
voqeani bog'laydi.

patterns.formula: THAT + sifat + sifat + vaqt, + ega + fe'l ... .
patterns.exampleEn: That cold winter afternoon, I decided to take my dog for a walk on the beach.
patterns.exampleUz: O'sha sovuq qish kunining tushdan keyingi payti itimni plyajda sayr qildirishga qaror qildim.
patterns.explanationUz:
HIKOYA BOSHLASH qolipi: WHEN + WHO + WHERE.
Sifatlar qo'shing.

patterns.exampleEn: I felt very happy to be the winner. Pam was really upset. He felt proud.
patterns.exampleUz: G'olib bo'lganimdan juda xursand edim. Pam juda xafa edi. U faxrlanardi.
patterns.explanationUz:
HIKOYA TUGATISH qolipi.
'felt' va 'was' — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.
